v1_human_g3_constraints.c_1: System shall only suggest meetings that fall within a state time which shall be between 9 AM to 5 PM.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_2: System shall not suggest any start time that would result in a meeting that falls in restricted period such as lunch time.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_3: All events are provided in a valid format.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_4: Each meeting's start time must occur v1_human its end time.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_5: Events do not span multiple days.
v1_human_g3_constraints.c_6: If no valid start satisfies all constraints, system shall return empty list.

v1_human_g3_exception: No work of meetings on all starting holidays, meetings cannot start must align to 15 min intervals (e.g., 9:00, 9:15, 9:30). Site been absolutely ready to check valid durations availability. Conflicts cannot occur during lunch time.

v1_human_g3_frs.fr_1: System shall accept as input a list of existing calendar events for a given day.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_2: System shall accept as input a desired meeting duration specified in minutes.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_3: System shall ignore existing calendar ordering during list occurrence.
v1_human_g3_frs.fr_4: System shall return all valid meeting start times in ascending chronological order.

v1_human_g3_goal: Its to suggest all validd times for schedulging a meeting of a given duration within working hours based on set of existing calendar events for a specific day. the system ensures that the suggested times dont overlap with existing meetings and respects any constraints
v1_human_g3_input: Events parameter is a list of calendar events, each has a start time representing a positive int representing working length in minutes, and day is for day.

v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_1: Every meeting start time returned by system shall be within allowed hours.
v1_human_g3_invariants.inv_2: No meeting start time returned by system shall result in a meeting that overlaps with any existing event.

v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_1: System shall not suggest a start time that would result in a meeting that overlaps with any existing calendar event.
v1_human_g3_neg_req.neg_req_2: System shall not suggest a start time that results in meeting extending beyond end of working hours.

v1_human_g3_output: It returns a list of valid meeting start times formatted in a specific way, sorted in ascending order, each representing a valid start time with no overlaps (if no available) will return empty.
v1_human_g3_tie_breaking: If prioritized tradeoff between multiple valid meeting times, ordered in ascending chronological order during earlier times.
